d: Patna Nagar Nigam Bond:bihar ke shahri vikas ke lihaj se aaj ka din behad aham raha... bihar ka pahla myunisipal bond neshnal stok eksachenj yani NSE men list ho gaya hai... patna nagar nigam ke 200 karor rupye ke bond ki listing ke mauke par mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri maujud rahe... karyakram men donon dipti siem aur mantri nitish mishra bhi shamil hue... is bond ke jarie patna nagar nigam ko shahri vikas aur buniyadi suvidhaon ke vistar ke lie vittiy sansadhan jutane ka naya madhyam mila hai...nagar nigam ke myunisipal bond ki listing ke mauke par mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne shahri…
